reviews.title: App wasn’t recording exercises
reviews.text:
So the app was recording exercises absolutely fine till the last update where there is clearly a bug as it’s recording in the “today” but not in your exercise list. 

Sent an email to explaining with video and screen shot and whoever it was who replied tried to imply it was user error even though I’ve had this app for 7 months, been using it fine and to get basically ignored and told it’s not a problem and not their issue is moronic and passing blame when given pictures and video of the issue puts me right off wanting to use the app. 

I’ll find a better one instead now.

reviews.title: Developers Keep Ruining a Once Beautiful App.
reviews.text: I have used this app for the past 2 years and now they just bloated with nonsense and every update they do introduces new bugs.

reviews.title: STILL CAN'T CHANGE DATES
reviews.text: Insane that I still can't change the date on my sets, the whole app wigs out and deletes sets, complete mess, they aren't smart enough to recognize or squash it. Wheres my refund?

reviews.title: No Transfer?
reviews.text: I got a new phone and none of my workouts, exercises or workout data transferred to my new phone. What’s the benefit of the pro membership??

reviews.title: Riddled with bugs
reviews.text: This app is good for tracking, but is riddled with bugs and broken features. The streak tracking is completely wrong, the calendar changes between openings, adding workouts frequently does not indicate it was added. It’s actually astonishing how many bugs there are for a paid app.

reviews.title: ScammerApp
reviews.text: Need refund. Never used. Cancelled ❌

reviews.title: Paywall
reviews.text: Huge paywall can’t even use the app for anything unless you spend money might as well make that app one of the ones you pay for. I hate when apps are like this.

reviews.title: DO NOT DOWNLOAD
reviews.text: This app asks you approximately 15 million questions before you can even get into the actual app

reviews.title: Stupid day streak
reviews.text: The new day streak pop up completely freezes app. Have had this app for a few years but I am going to delete if they do not fix it. Spend half time I have to work out trying to clear pop up that won’t let you do anything in the app until it clears. Have tried restarting everything and still comes up and freezes app.

reviews.title: Bugged
reviews.text: Logged one set for bench press and upon “streak start” notification the entire app froze. Could not remove the notification and would come up every time the app was started. Disappointing after the app looked promising.

reviews.title: AI powered
reviews.text: I was excited about this but got to the part that it uses AI and I refuse to feed that machine while it’s killing our planet and our health

reviews.title: Taken subscription twice
reviews.text: Why have you taken a year subscription twice?

reviews.title: Now very glitchy
reviews.text: Used for over a year but recently become very glitchy

reviews.title: Bug found
reviews.text: When the set timer is running and you turn your phone off, when you turn it back on and press the timer to open the app from your lock screen, the app is blank and needs to be restarted for anything to load.

reviews.title: New update is terrible
reviews.text:
I LOVED this app but every update is worse! 
The kg to lb button is in the most annoying spot, and I’m constantly having to redo my entries for entire workouts! 
Now the most recent update CRASHES every time the app is minimized  and has to be closed out and restarted every time to make an entry! 
So sad I have to switch after years using this!

reviews.title: Doesn’t do what it describes
reviews.text:
I have created workouts and added sets and weights per set, but there doesn’t seem to be a way to start a session and log that workout in that session and then change the reps and weights each time you do the workout?

Really unhappy with the app as it seems like it could do everything I needed but now just feels like my money was wasted..

And the only support seems to be via X which I do not use? Why can’t I email for support?

reviews.title: Avoid!
reviews.text: They don’t let you export data. So if you want to analyze it you can’t. They admitted that was on purpose.

reviews.title: No data export feature
reviews.text: This would be a great app if an export function was available so we can analyze our data in AI.   Canceling membership to find another app.

reviews.title: Price
reviews.text: Brilliant app, I used this every day but recent price increases for the pro version feel unreasonable to me. I get that even simple apps can cost a lot to create and maintain but at the end of the day paying £250, £50 a year or £8.99 a month!!! Is way to much for something that simply records workout reps and weights
